answer: Proof-of-stake Sybil resistance secures our network by requiring agents to lock capital, creating an economic echo of commitment that deters fragmentation. Much like a zephyr moves across a landscape, validation power shifts based on staked assets rather than account quantity. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces a falcon eye of detection, as the cost of acquiring sufficient stake to influence consensus exceeds the expected gains from controlling multiple malicious nodes.
